name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)
tests: SAT or ACT required. English test (TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge or Duolingo) strongly recommended for non-native speakers; MIT's guidance is roughly TOEFL 90 minimum / 100 recommended and IELTS 7 minimum / 7.5 recommended.

name: Imperial College London
tests: No SAT/ACT. Engineering and physical sciences use the ESAT, some maths/computing courses the TMUA, and medicine the UCAT. English: Imperial 'standard' level IELTS 6.5 (6.0 each) or 'higher' level IELTS 7.0 (6.5 each), depending on course.

name: Stanford University
tests: SAT or ACT required. No English test is required, but non-native speakers may submit TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo results.

name: University of Oxford
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement, but most courses require a subject admissions test (e.g. MAT, TSA, LNAT, ESAT, UCAT) taken in October. English: IELTS 7.5 (7.0 in each part) or TOEFL iBT 110, unless exempt.

name: Harvard University
tests: SAT or ACT required (in exceptional cases AP, IB, A-Level or national exam results can substitute). No English test is required; non-native speakers may submit TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo voluntarily.

name: University of Cambridge
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement; many courses use admissions tests (ESAT, TMUA, LNAT, UCAT) or college-set written assessments. English: IELTS 7.5 (usually 7.0 in each part) or TOEFL iBT 110.

name: California Institute of Technology (Caltech)
tests: SAT or ACT required. TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo required unless English is your native language or your school's language of instruction, taken before the deadline.

name: ETH Zurich (Swiss Federal Institute of Technology)
tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught in German: proof of German at C1 level (e.g. Goethe C1, TestDaF) by the deadline. Depending on your country's certificate, you may need ETH's reduced or comprehensive entrance examination.

name: UCL (University College London)
tests: No SAT/ACT; some programmes require tests (TMUA for Economics, LNAT for Law, UCAT for Medicine). English: five levels from IELTS 6.5 (6.0 each) up to IELTS 8.0, depending on programme; TOEFL accepted.

name: National University of Singapore (NUS)
tests: SAT/ACT required for some curricula (e.g., US high school diploma); otherwise optional. English: IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL ~92 if English was not your medium of instruction.

name: The University of Hong Kong (HKU)
tests: SAT/ACT and AP are accepted as part of US-curriculum qualifications; IB, A-level and many national diplomas accepted. Applicants whose school language is not English must meet HKU's English language requirement (IELTS/TOEFL and others; see the official page).

name: Nanyang Technological University (NTU Singapore)
tests: SAT/ACT needed for some curricula; SAT 1250 (R&W 600) or ACT 30 can also satisfy the English requirement. English: IELTS 6.5 (Writing & Speaking 6.5) / TOEFL 90 / PTE 55 / C1 Advanced 170.

name: Peking University
tests: No SAT/ACT; entry is by application review plus the university's written test and/or interview (some applicants exempted with strong international scores). English: needed only for English-taught programmes. Chinese-taught degrees require HSK 5–6 (level varies by major).

name: Tsinghua University
tests: No SAT/ACT; entry is by application review plus the university's written test and/or interview (some applicants exempted with strong international scores). English: needed only for English-taught programmes. Chinese-taught degrees require HSK 5–6 (level varies by major).

name: University of Pennsylvania
tests: SAT or ACT required (hardship waiver available). TOEFL, IELTS Academic or Duolingo required unless English is your native language or you have 3+ years of English-medium study; competitive TOEFL ≈ 5+ on the new 1–6 scale.

name: Cornell University
tests: SAT or ACT required for fall 2026 entry and later. English: TOEFL iBT 5.0 minimum (5.5 recommended) on the new scale, IELTS Academic 7.5, Duolingo 130 or Cambridge C1/C2 191.

name: Yale University
tests: SAT or ACT required for the 2026-27 cycle. Non-native English speakers should submit TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo; successful applicants typically score TOEFL 100+ (old scale), IELTS 7+ or Duolingo 120+.

name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)
tests: Minimum SAT 1190 / ACT 24 for US-pattern applicants (plus AP tests). English: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall or TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before 21 Jan 2026; 4.5/6 on the new TOEFL scale), or SAT EBRW 590 / ACT ELA 23. IELTS Online, One Skill Retake and TOEFL Home Edition are not accepted.

name: UNSW Sydney (University of New South Wales)
tests: English: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall (min 6.0 in each band) or TOEFL iBT 90 (min 23 writing, 22 reading, listening, speaking); PTE Academic and C1 Advanced also accepted; some degrees require more. IELTS Online not accepted; the new TOEFL format is under review.

name: Johns Hopkins University
tests: SAT or ACT required (reinstated from fall 2025 applicants). Non-native speakers submit TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo; JHU has historically recommended about TOEFL 100 / IELTS 7 / Duolingo 125.

name: University of California, Berkeley
tests: Test-blind: SAT/ACT are not considered. English: IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 115 or TOEFL iBT (80 on the old scale; UC lists 4.5 on the new 2026 scale) unless exempt.

name: EPFL (École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne)
tests: No SAT/ACT. First-year bachelor teaching is mainly in French (some English later): applicants without francophone schooling need a French certificate (B2 recommended). Some non-EU certificates require EPFL's entrance exam.

name: The University of Melbourne
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement as such: you are assessed on your secondary qualification (IB, A-levels, a US diploma with SAT/ACT/AP, etc.) against each course's entry score. English: the University's undergraduate English standard, with IELTS Academic the usual test; some courses set higher bands. Official score tables could not be verified automatically.
gpa_note: Entry is by course-specific scores for your qualification (e.g. high IB totals or strong A-level grades); competitive courses like Biomedicine and Commerce need top results.

name: University of Chicago
tests: Test-optional with a 'no harm' policy (scores only used if they help). English proficiency must be clear from the application; any recognised exam (TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo, etc.) may be submitted, no fixed minimum.

name: Technical University of Munich (TUM)
tests: No SAT/ACT in general, but some programmes run an aptitude assessment (grades, essay, possibly interview). Most bachelor's are in German (DSH-2/TestDaF 4); English-taught bachelor's (e.g. Management & Technology, Information Engineering at TUM Campus Heilbronn) need IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 88.

name: Fudan University
tests: No SAT/ACT; entry is by application review plus the university's written test and/or interview (some applicants exempted with strong international scores). English: needed only for English-taught programmes. Chinese-taught degrees require HSK 5–6 (level varies by major).

name: Princeton University
tests: Test-optional for fall 2026 and fall 2027 entry; SAT/ACT will be required from fall 2028 entry. English test (TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or PTE) required unless English is your native language or you studied 3+ years in English; no published minimum.

name: The University of Sydney
tests: Standard English requirement: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0 (some courses higher); TOEFL iBT (Australia version, Home Edition not accepted), PTE and LanguageCert accepted via the concordance table. Tests must be under two years old at course start.

name: Australian National University (ANU)
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; you need an accepted secondary qualification meeting the indicative entry score for your program. English (ANU policy): IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, TOEFL iBT 80 (TOEFL iBT Australia only for tests from 21 Jan 2026), PTE Academic 64, Cambridge C1/C2 176. At-home/online test versions are not accepted. Some programs set higher requirements.
gpa_note: Assessed against ANU's indicative entry score for your qualification (high IB/A-level results for competitive programs); some programs add selection criteria.

name: McGill University
tests: SAT/ACT optional or programme-dependent for US-curriculum applicants; IB, A-Level and national diplomas accepted. English: IELTS Academic 6.5 (6.0 each), TOEFL iBT 90 (old scale) or Duolingo 120 unless exempt.
